# Found First

Contact: nick@befoundfirst.ai

## Perspectives

- [ChatGPT ads vs. Google Ads](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/chatgpt-ads-vs-google-ads/): ChatGPT ads or Google Ads? Found First brings a commercial point of view to the conversation. Your business deserves more than a platform preference.

- [Choosing an AEO agency](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/choose-aeo-agency/): Choose an AEO agency with conviction, clear answers and a real point of view. Meet Found First and decide whether the ambition matches yours.

- [AEO for multi-location brands](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/aeo-for-multi-location-brands/): A bigger footprint should come with a presence to match. Found First helps multi-location brands compete for attention in AI search.
